criteria.statement: tokens.css defines all eight named surface roles for each of the six profiles
Computed contrast meets the measured floors (14.37:1 / 6.19:1 / 5.42:1) in every profile against its darkest wash point
No profile's wash renders darker than #09090B
Neutral ground/panel fill is the visual majority in every profile at both viewports
motifs/ holds one original local asset per colour; no official Wizards of the Coast artwork
shell.css is the single source of the chrome skeleton; no per-page duplicate
All 12 before screenshots exist under docs/design/ui-reimagining/before/, captured from the live dev app
Cleanup evidence recorded: browser closed, owned dev server stopped, ports released, capture path recorded
